name: seed_terminale_a1_a2_subject_coefficients
query: INSERT INTO public.subjects(name,description,is_active,is_test_data,display_order) SELECT 'Conduite','Matière Bulletin réservée aux coefficients fournis pour Terminale A1 et A2.',true,false,999 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.subjects WHERE name='Conduite'); INSERT INTO public.course_subject_offerings(subject_id,level_id,series_id,is_published,is_test_data,display_order) SELECT sub.id,l.id,sr.id,false,false,999 FROM public.subjects sub CROSS JOIN public.levels l CROSS JOIN public.series sr WHERE sub.name='Conduite' AND l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('A1','A2') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.course_subject_offerings o WHERE o.subject_id=sub.id AND o.level_id=l.id AND o.series_id=sr.id); WITH supplied(level_name,series_name,subject_name,subject_coefficient) AS (VALUES Sportive',1::numeric),('Terminale','A1','Conduite',1::numeric),('Terminale','A2','Français',4::numeric),('Terminale','A2','Anglais',4::numeric),('Terminale','A2','Histoire-Géographie',3::numeric),('Terminale','A2','Allemand',3::numeric),('Terminale','A2','Espagnol',3::numeric),('Terminale','A2','Mathématiques',2::numeric),('Terminale','A2','Philosophie',5::numeric),('Terminale','A2','Sciences Sportive',1::numeric),('Terminale','A2','Conduite',1::numeric)), resolved AS (SELECT supplied.*,o.id AS offering_id FROM supplied JOIN public.levels l ON l.name=supplied.level_name JOIN public.series sr ON sr.name=supplied.series_name JOIN public.subjects sub ON sub.name=supplied.subject_name JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.level_id=l.id AND o.series_id=sr.id AND o.subject_id=sub.id) demandeur','Commande 10.1 — Coefficients Terminale A1/A2 + calcul pondéré des notes','Section 1 — Coefficients des matières','15 août 2026',NULL FROM resolved WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM
